content.short: Outmine is a dungeon survival game where players mine resources, fight rivals, and try to escape with loot.
content.description: Outmine is a browser and Telegram game from Rogues Studio built around short dungeon runs. The official site describes a loop where players drop into a dungeon, mine resources, battle enemies and other players, survive for two minutes, and climb tournaments for prizes. Rogues Studio also highlights companion systems such as Outmine Pets and regular competitive events, which makes the app feel closer to an arcade survival game than a passive clicker. The overall design is built around quick sessions, repeat play, and leaderboard competition rather than long form world building or passive farming loops.
content.meta: Outmine is a dungeon survival game from Rogues Studio with mining, PvP combat, short runs, tournaments, and Telegram based access.
